packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch/pin/digest updates directly on branch
eslint-config-next's plugins (eslint-plugin-react, typescript-eslint) do not support ESLint 10 yet - it crashes on any lint run. Unpin once they do.

better-auth 1.7.x renamed/removed generic-oauth plugin API (signInWithOAuth2, oAuth2Callback, the issuer config field) that lib/betterAuth.ts and the OIDC routes depend on - it breaks the type check and the OIDC login flow. Unpin once that integration is updated to match the new API.

better-auth 1.6.x only declares better-sqlite3 ^12 as a peer; better-sqlite3 13 makes `npm ci` fail outright (ERESOLVE) in the Docker build, which does not use --legacy-peer-deps. Bump this together with the better-auth pin above once that's unblocked, not before.
